ratios.quote: Our actual interest coverage for the four consecutive quarters ended September 30, 2026 was 2.28 , which is above the minimum interest coverage of 2.00 .
Our actual maximum secured leverage ratio for the four consecutive quarters ended September 30, 2026 was 1.37 , which is below the newly established maximum secured leverage ratio of 3.50 .
The maximum leverage ratio was not tested for the four consecutive quarters ended September 30, 2026 in connection with the April 2026 Amendment.

parsed.notes: Under the April 2026 Amendment, the maximum leverage ratio (debt to adjusted earnings) was not tested for the first three quarters of 2026. It rises to 6.75 through December 31, 2027 and then steps down to 3.75 by March 31, 2029. The minimum interest coverage requirement is 2.00 through June 30, 2027 and then steps up to 3.50 by March 31, 2029. The secured leverage covenant (maximum 3.50) is new under the April 2026 Amendment. The company states it was in compliance with all covenants at September 30, 2026. Amendment No. 8 (October 2026) relates to the India business sale proceeds and the release of guarantors and collateral.
